headline: West Germany Crowned World Champions, Defeat Netherlands 2-1 in Munich Final
dispatch: West Germany claimed the FIFA World Cup title in Munich on July 7, 1974, defeating the Netherlands 2-1 at the Olympiastadion. Gerd Muller struck the winning goal in the second half to seal victory for the hosts. The Dutch, playing their celebrated total football, had taken the lead from the penalty spot before the Germans rallied to overturn the deficit.
answer: West Germany defeats Netherlands in World Cup final, 1974
